"""Bulk-loads products from the catalog DB into the search index."""
import json, os, requests

ES = os.environ.get("ES_URL", "http://search.internal:9200")
INDEX = "products"  # concrete index name; no alias in use today


def bulk_load(rows):
  body = "".join(json.dumps({"index": {"_index": INDEX, "_id": r["sku"]}}) + "\n" + json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in rows)
  requests.post(f"{ES}/_bulk", data=body, headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-ndjson"}).raise_for_status()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Rebuilds the products index from scratch. WARNING: drops the live index first;
# search returns empty results until the bulk load finishes (~40 min).
set -euo pipefail
curl -sf -X DELETE "$ES_URL/products"
curl -sf -X PUT "$ES_URL/products" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @search/mappings/products.json
python3 -m search.indexer --all

"""Builds training datasets by joining labels with feature values."""
import pandas as pd

SESSION_FEATURE_TTL_DAYS = 30


def build_training_set(labels: pd.DataFrame, feature_values: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
  # Take the most recent value per (entity, feature).
  latest = (feature_values.sort_values("event_timestamp")
            .groupby(["customer_id", "feature"]).tail(1))
  wide = latest.pivot(index="customer_id", columns="feature", values="value").reset_index()
  out = labels.merge(wide, on="customer_id", how="left")
  cutoff = out["label_timestamp"] - pd.Timedelta(days=SESSION_FEATURE_TTL_DAYS)
  return out[out["label_timestamp"] >= cutoff]
